shipping_rates_days_ok.name: shipping_rates_days_ok

shipping_rates_weight_ok.name: shipping_rates_weight_ok
shipping_rates_weight_ok.value: "shipping_rates"."min_weight_grams" is null or "shipping_rates"."max_weight_grams" is null or "shipping_rates"."min_weight_grams" < "shipping_rates"."max_weight_grams"

suppliers_email_has_contact.name: suppliers_email_has_contact
suppliers_email_has_contact.value: "suppliers"."provider" <> 'email' or ("suppliers"."contact_email" is not null and "suppliers"."name" is not null)
